definitions.isolated: one spike interval in the day
definitions.sustained: four or more spike intervals, not necessarily consecutive
definitions.relative: exceeds the 99th percentile of the previous 30 complete market days
definitions.counterfactual: Remove D largest interval only for diagnostic threshold calculation; never modify the actual target

limitations: Descriptive exploration; group sizes may be small, groups overlap, no causal inference or new forecasting rule. Oracle gains are unattainable upper bounds.
